_note: Which sections are each zone topic's own policy. zone_primary is set from this, and it is the only tag search may exclude on, so a section listed here has to be a rule that applies inside that zone and nowhere else. gazette_sections are section numbers, and a number also covers everything under it, so 4.2 covers 4.2.1. faq_section_phrases are matched against a FAQ section heading, case-insensitively, and only an explicit topic name counts. zone_o is empty in both halves: MPD-2047 has no Zone O policy, so Zone O boosts a result and expands a query but never excludes. See D-023, D-024, D-037 and D-038.
